subject: Security exhibit: notice windows, sampling, and pen-test coordination
messages:
From: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@healthsync.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit & audit scheduling — request

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks for working with us on the MSA and order form. A couple of items we need clarity on before procurement can sign:

- Notice period for inspection/assessments: our security team expects a maximum of 48 hours' notice for remote evidence requests and 72 hours for on-site / interactive inspections.
- Audit scope: we'd like the right to verify SOC 2 controls in-scope for Customer Data, and to request pen-test reports covering the last 12 months.
- Sampling vs full inspection: can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a sampling approach (representative logs/config snapshots) or do you require a full production walkthrough?
- Evidence cadence: for ongoing compliance we typically request log extracts monthly and quarterly attestation updates; what's feasible operationally?

Attached is our assurance questionnaire with a few marked items (HealthSync_assurance_questions.xlsx). Can you confirm expected turnaround and any gating steps (NDA, scheduling link)?

Appreciate a short call to align — Tom and I are available Mon/Tue next week.

Thanks,
Monica
Security Program Manager
HealthSync

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@healthsync.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit & audit scheduling — request

Laura / Karthik — looping you in with HealthSync's asks. Quick summary and my proposed positions so we can agree on redlines before responding:

1) Notice windows: HealthSync wants 48h remote / 72h on-site. We should push to 5 business days for any interactive inspection (or 3 business days for remote evidence pulls) to avoid operational disruption.
2) Audit scope: agree to provide SOC 2 in-scope controls for Customer Data under NDA. For pen-tests, we can provide summary reports and remediation timelines — full raw findings require redaction and may need a legal gating clause.
3) Sampling vs full inspection: propose a sampling model (pre-agreed sample sets + live session limited to sanitized views). On production walkthroughs, we need mutually non-disruptive test language and clear exclusions (no privileged key access, no destructive testing).
4) Evidence cadence: operationally we can commit to monthly log extracts for the prior 30 days and quarterly control attestations. Full historical archives can be delivered on a scheduled cadence (subscription add-on or professional services).

Next steps: Laura, can you draft a short redline for the exhibit addressing: notice period (business days), scope limited to SOC 2 + defined lists, pen-test summary deliverable + 90-day remediation SLA, and a nondisruptive testing clause? Karthik, please flag any non-negotiable legal bits (e.g., inspection frequency cap, confidentiality of reports).

I'll prepare a concise reply to Monica with proposed language and available dates for a sync.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@healthsync.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit & audit scheduling — request

Grace / Karthik — draft redline below (snippet) that I think balances HealthSync's ask with our operational constraints. Please review and confirm before I send.

--- Proposed security exhibit language (redline snippet):

1. Audit Rights and Scheduling
   a. Customer may request, no more frequently than once per 12 months, an inspection to verify Redwood's controls in-scope for Customer Data. Additional inspections may be permitted for cause (material incident) subject to Redwood's reasonable operational availability.
   b. For remote evidence requests, Customer will provide at least three (3) business days' advance written notice. For on-site or interactive inspections, Customer will provide at least five (5) business days' advance written notice.

2. Scope and Evidence
   a. Redwood will provide Customer with (i) the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the in-scope controls, subject to a standard NDA; (ii) redacted pen-test summary reports for the prior 12 months.
   b. Customer and Redwood will mutually agree on representative sample sets for log/configuration evidence to limit scope to Customer Data and relevant control families.

3. Penetration Testing
   a. Redwood will provide a non-sensitive executive summary of third-party penetration tests and a statement of remediation status. Detailed vulnerability reports, raw exploit data, and any vendor-sensitive artifacts will be redacted.
   b. Any active testing against Redwood systems must be coordinated and scheduled outside normal business hours unless otherwise agreed in writing; tests must be non-destructive and cannot require access to production secrets or KMS.

4. Operational Commitments
   a. Redwood will provide monthly log extracts (rolling 30-day window) upon Customer's reasonable request, subject to rate limits and scheduled delivery.
   b. Redwood will commit to remediate critical findings from vendor-validated penetration tests within ninety (90) calendar days of validation, with interim communications and mitigation plans.

---

Karthik — flagging items for legal: frequency cap (once per 12 months), notice window in business days, explicit exclusion of privileged secrets, and redaction of raw pen-test data. If that's acceptable I'll send this back to HealthSync along with suggested slots for a 30-minute sync (Mon/Tue next week).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@healthsync.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit & audit scheduling — request

Hi Monica / Tom,

Thanks for the clear ask and the attached questionnaire — appreciated. Laura and Karthik and I discussed and we can agree to a path that should meet HealthSync's assurance needs while protecting operational stability and vendor confidentiality. High-level proposal below; full redline attached (redline_MSAsnippet.pdf).

What we can commit to:
- Annual inspection right (no more frequently than once per 12 months) with additional inspections for cause.
- Notice: 3 business days for remote evidence requests; 5 business days for interactive/on-site sessions.
- Scope: SOC 2 Type II report (in-scope controls for Customer Data) available under a standard NDA; pen-test summary reports (redacted) for the prior 12 months.
- Sampling: we will mutually agree on representative sample sets for log/configuration requests; full production walkthroughs are limited to non-privileged, non-destructive sessions.
- Evidence cadence: monthly rolling 30-day log extracts on request (scheduled delivery) and quarterly control attestations.
- Pen-test remediation: Redwood will communicate validated findings and target remediation for critical items within 90 days, with interim mitigation status updates.

Operational items to align on call:
- Which control families and systems HealthSync needs in scope (e.g., data access, encryption at rest/in transit, logging).
- Whether HealthSync prefers remote evidence-only vs desired live session.
- Proposed dates: Mon 2028-06-24 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 2028-06-25 14:00-14:30 PT.

If that direction works, Laura will circulate the redline snippet and I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm a time slot. We will also share the SOC 2 report under our standard NDA (I can send the NDA if you don't already have one on file).

Best,
Grace
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_MSAsnippet.pdf (proposed exhibit language), HealthSync_assurance_questions.xlsx (received)
